research.facts:
Klay Thompson's Miami Introduction
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Klay Thompson signed a 2yr/$11.48M deal with the Miami Heat; includes 2027-28 player option
- Thompson cleared waivers following his Dallas Mavericks buyout (gave up ~$10M in remaining Dallas salary)
- He was officially introduced to the Heat on August 25, 2026
- Thompson's quote: "I still have a lot to prove"
- Thompson on Giannis: "Giannis is one of the best players of all time. He is a special talent. Great respect for him."
- Thompson joined Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo, Bobby Portis, and Tim Hardaway Jr. in Miami
- Thompson chose Miami for "the opportunity to play high-level basketball throughout the season and make a deep postseason run"
- Thompson was a 4x NBA champion with Golden State (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022)
- Career-worst 11.7 ppg in Dallas 2025-26 season
- Thompson said he "still has a lot to prove" at his Heat introduction press conference
**Verified Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Heat's offseason described as "epic" by analysts — added Giannis, Portis, Klay in one summer
- Thompson's role expected to be floor-spacing shooter around Giannis/Bam
**Source:** NBA.com, ESPN, local10.com, clutchpoints.com, Bleacher Report

research.facts:
Stephen Curry Extension — 3 Days Away
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- August 29, 2026 is the extension eligibility window opening date
- Maximum extension value: 2yr/$136.7M (through age-40 season)
- Warriors GM Mike Dunleavy said he is "pretty confident Steph will finish his career" in Golden State
- Mutual interest confirmed by ESPN's Anthony Slater
- If not signed, Curry would become an UFA in 2027 for the first time in his career
- Warriors' 2025-26 record: 37-45
- Curry shot 42% from 3 in 2025-26 at age 38
**Verified Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- ESPN's Brian Windhorst suggested Curry wait and test UFA market — one alternative floated: 1yr/$62.6M
- Some reports suggest deal could be 2yr max or 1yr bridge; most expect the 2yr max
- Flashscore reported: "Golden State Warriors' Stephen Curry reportedly agrees to one-year, $62.6M extension" — conflicting with most other reports; may reflect an alternative structure discussed
**Note:** Extension has NOT been signed as of August 26. Window opens Saturday Aug 29.

research.facts:
Kawhi Leonard Trade — Frozen Until Sept 22
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Trade agreed in principle at end of June 2026: Kawhi Leonard to Toronto Raptors for Brandon Ingram + Gradey Dick + unprotected 2031 and 2033 1sts + 2027 pick swap + 2 seconds
- Trade put on hold due to NBA investigation (Aspiration company allegation — Clippers funneled cap-circumvention money to Leonard via bankrupt company)
- Leonard personally cleared by NBA investigation
- Clippers sanctions still expected (not Leonard personally)
- Outside counsel fact-finding completed ~August 10
- Resolution expected around September 22
- Toronto Raptors training camp: September 28 in Quebec City (Université Laval)
- All-Star Game confirmed at Intuit Dome for 2026 (despite investigation)
**Source:** ESPN, NBA.com, Yahoo Sports
